highlights: Child Protection Policy supporting the Child Protection Act of Thailand
Child Protection Team for reporting and investigating concerns
Anonymous reporting platform for discreet reporting
On-site school nurse and referral to Paolo Memorial Hospital for urgent care
safety.policy_summary: Bangkok-Chicago Christian International School enforces a comprehensive Child Protection and Safeguarding Policy aligned with Thai legislation and UN conventions. All staff members are required to know how to respond to and report suspected child abuse. The school features a Child Protection Team, clear protocols for addressing disclosures or suspicions, and an anonymous reporting platform to ensure community safety and well-being.
